unit.target: Cargo cargo fetch dependency prefetch and locked/offline constraints
verified_findings: With Cargo.lock present, cargo fetch ensures git and registry dependencies are downloaded and locally available; subsequent Cargo commands can run offline unless the lock file changes.
Without Cargo.lock, cargo fetch generates the lock file before fetching dependencies.
--locked fails when the lock file is missing or would change.
--offline prevents network access and restricts resolution to dependencies already downloaded locally; resolution may differ from online mode.
unit.inference: cargo fetch can prepare the local dependency cache required for later offline Cargo operations, but that preparation itself is a network-fetching Cargo command and this leaf does not establish any scheduled-Chat-native Cargo executor.

scope_guard: Evidence is limited to documented cargo fetch behavior and --locked/--offline/--frozen semantics. It does not prove the dependency cache exists, cargo fetch can execute inside scheduled Chat, cargo vendor can execute there, an end-to-end build can run offline, or richer-mode outcome parity.
